title: 21bitcoin Now Pays Interest on Idle Euros, Payable in BTC
summary: Bitcoin Magazine 21bitcoin Now Pays Interest on Idle Euros, Payable in BTC Austrian Bitcoin platform 21bitcoin will pay customers interest on their euro balances — in bitcoin if they want. This post 21bitcoin Now Pays Interest on Idle Euros, Payable in BTC first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Mathew Di Salvo .
